title: AI贡献GDP增长：三分之二？，美联储理事当场被问
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: When I look at the economy and I look at a stable labor market, strong growth, those are both positives, but inflation is too high and has been for some time.
segments.zh: 当我审视经济，看到稳定的劳动力市场、强劲的增长，这些都是积极因素，但通胀过高且已持续一段时间。

segments.en: We've had a series of shocks in the economy that have kept inflation somewhat elevated, so I think we're going to need to adjust monetary policy further to bring us into better balance
segments.zh: 经济经历了一系列冲击，使通胀保持在一定高位，因此我认为需要进一步调整货币政策，以更好地平衡这些风险。

segments.en: on those risks. But you see monetary policy right now as accommodative, not restrictive.
segments.zh: 但你认为当前的货币政策是宽松的，而非限制性的。

segments.en: Well, I would say what I see is, and what I said and what I see is, the financial conditions broadly are accommodative.
segments.zh: 嗯，我想说我所看到的是，正如我所说，整体金融环境是宽松的。

segments.en: Interest rate policy is one aspect of what contributes to financial conditions, so I'm really talking more broadly about financial conditions.
segments.zh: 利率政策是影响金融环境的一个方面，所以我更多是在更广泛地谈论金融环境。

segments.en: I know you said that you at the Fed do not target particular industries or markets, but there is a lot of concern right now about whether investment in AI is a boom or a bubble.
segments.zh: 我知道你说过美联储不针对特定行业或市场，但目前很多人担心人工智能领域的配置是繁荣还是泡沫。

segments.en: I was just looking up some numbers this morning that came out from Torsten's lock at Apollo, and he had calculated that AI investment added roughly 1.3 percentage points to real GDP growth
segments.zh: 我今早刚查了一些数据，来自Apollo的Torsten Slok，他计算出人工智能领域的配置在过去三个季度为实际GDP增长贡献了约1.3个百分点。

segments.en: over the past three quarters, so it's about two thirds of cumulative growth led by software and computers.
segments.zh: 所以这大约占累计增长的三分之二，主要由软件和计算机驱动。
